summary: Fever is a temporary increase in body temperature, usually caused by an infection.
when_to_see_doctor: Seek medical advice if the fever is above 103°F (39.4°C), lasts more than 3 days, or is accompanied by severe symptoms.

summary: Diabetes is a chronic condition where the body cannot properly regulate blood sugar levels due to insulin problems.
when_to_see_doctor: Consult a doctor if you experience persistent symptoms such as extreme thirst, frequent urination, or unexplained weight loss.

summary: The common cold is a viral infection of the upper respiratory tract.
when_to_see_doctor: See a doctor if symptoms last more than 10 days or if you develop high fever or breathing difficulties.

summary: A headache is pain or discomfort in the head or face area and can have multiple causes.
symptoms: Pain or pressure in the head
when_to_see_doctor: Seek medical attention if headaches are severe, sudden, or accompanied by confusion, vision loss, or difficulty speaking.

summary: Influenza (flu) is a contagious viral infection that affects the respiratory system.
when_to_see_doctor: Consult a doctor if symptoms are severe, worsen quickly, or if breathing becomes difficult.
